notes.notes:
[u][b][h2]Changes in the Game:[/h2][/b][/u]

[b]ENHANCEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Lafaya UI Notifications
[*] New Layafa logic based on difficulty

[*] Added new leaderboard description panel
[*] Review the Boss fight - Wave 3
[*] Fixed the issue related to cutscenes subtitles whereby the texts were sometimes hidden behind the character's picture.
[/list]
Thanks for the support and comments!

notes.title: Our Discord Server is live
notes.notes:
To our esteemed fans,

We wish to thank everybody who has supported our game through their purchase. Being an indie developer can be quite challenging; without your support and trust, our endeavour would not have been successful.

Our commitment to you, the fans, is to create a positive gaming experience. After listening to your comments, we've created this Discord channel where you can provide your feedback, share your thoughts and together help us build the Project Boost community. Our development team will go through all the suggestions; we will seek to implement the most popular ones, to the extent possible. Immersion Plus has dedicated a team to ensure that your comments on both Steam and Discord are answered within 24hours! This is our pledge to you.

[b][url=https://discord.gg/PZepsNyV]Project Boost Discord[/url][/b]

We also invite you to share your screenshots and videos on the Steam platform.

Looking forward to hearing from you


Yours Faithfully

Immersion Plus

notes.title: Developers' Release Message
notes.notes:
Greetings from [b]Mauritius[/b], here at [b]Immersion Plus[/b] we are excited to present you our first video game release. It's been a rich and incredible 1-year journey. We like to take this opportunity to thank our fans, friends and family for their support; without you this game would not be possible!

[b]Project Boost[/b] has been inspired by retro hero shooter games which we, as developers, love to play as kid. Our vision from the start was to immerse you, the gamer, as a hero-shooter and triumph against hordes of enemies. It was one of our primary goal to create an unforgiving environment which can describe as "unfair" and "hard".  [b]Project Boost[/b] is, at its very core, a "shoot-em up" retro game, but it requires the player to hone every mechanic of the game to win!

Initially planned to be released in 2020, [b]Immersion Plus[/b] has postponed the release date because the game "[i]was not ready[/i]"! Within that time, our team has unapologetically updated the game to its current version which is true to our vision but most importantly, [b]pleases our fans![/b]

Our commitment and passion towards making this game a better experience for the fans will be unwavering. Our team will be constantly reading your feedback and review.

We hope you enjoy our game.

[b]Immersion Plus[/b]
